Your numbers and ticks stay in this browser.

## Page budget

Pages of writing, images and score, plus **2 pages for every minute** of audio or video. Everything counts except the
bibliography. Over 30 and the rest is not marked.

::: {.crs}
<div id="ep-budget"></div>
:::

## Task 1: Investigating (A)

::: {.crs}
<ul class="ep-list" data-ep="a">
<li>My topic is a genre or movement of music, not one song, artist or technique, and my teacher has agreed it.</li>
<li>Ai covers context, concepts and characteristics of the genre, with examples from more than one recording.</li>
<li>Ai is about the genre as a whole, not artists' biographies.</li>
<li>Every section links back to "Art questions power and privilege".</li>
<li>Aii critiques one recording with at least one element, one technique and one context, in similar depth.</li>
<li>Aii is about the music (with time stamps), not only the lyrics.</li>
<li>Aii ends with a judgement: strengths and limitations.</li>
<li>Every source is cited in the text and in the MLA bibliography.</li>
</ul>
:::

## Task 2: Developing (B)

::: {.crs}
<ul class="ep-list" data-ep="b">
<li>Bi has audio or video clips from the beginning, the middle and towards the end.</li>
<li>No screenshot or photo stands in for a clip (screenshots only beside the audio of that draft).</li>
<li>Each clip says what I tried, what changed, and why.</li>
<li>Clips play at normal speed, with no voice-over drowning the music, and my part is clear.</li>
<li>Bii was written before the final work and looks forward.</li>
<li>Bii links the intention to the statement of inquiry.</li>
<li>Each artistic choice is justified with a reason: a Task 1 finding or a Bi clip.</li>
<li>Bii says why I chose this idea over the others I tried.</li>
</ul>
:::

## Task 3: Creating/Performing (C)

::: {.crs}
<ul class="ep-list" data-ep="c">
<li>The final recording has good sound, and on video my hands and instrument are in shot.</li>
<li>If it is a portion, I say which part, with time stamps.</li>
<li>Title, performers and instruments are listed.</li>
<li>The music is mine; any AI use is stated and cited.</li>
</ul>
:::

## Task 4: Evaluating (D)

::: {.crs}
<ul class="ep-list" data-ep="d">
<li>Di judges the finished recording, not the process.</li>
<li>Di weighs strengths and limitations of elements and techniques, with time stamps.</li>
<li>Di measures the piece against my artistic intention and the statement of inquiry.</li>
<li>Dii is about me as a musician: skills, learning moments, changing intentions, influences.</li>
<li>Each skill in Dii points to evidence (a Bi clip).</li>
<li>Dii says what did not improve and what I will do next.</li>
</ul>
:::

## Before you upload

::: {.crs}
<ul class="ep-list" data-ep="u">
<li>The page budget is 30 or under.</li>
<li>Every file is uploaded; there are no links to YouTube or other sites.</li>
<li>Normal font size; nothing needs zooming to read.</li>
<li>The template's italic prompts are deleted.</li>
</ul>
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var K = CourseKit, esc = K.esc;
  var TASKS = [["Task 1 · A", "6–8"], ["Task 2 · B", "8"], ["Task 3 · C", "6–8"], ["Task 4 · D", "6"]];
  var bud = K.load("eportfolio-budget", {});
  var box = document.getElementById("ep-budget");
  var rows = TASKS.map(function (t, i) {
    var r = bud[i] || {};
    return "<tr><td>" + t[0] + "</td><td>" + t[1] + "</td>" +
      '<td><input type="number" min="0" step="0.5" data-i="' + i + '" data-k="p" value="' + esc(r.p || "") + '"></td>' +
      '<td><input type="number" min="0" step="0.25" data-i="' + i + '" data-k="m" value="' + esc(r.m || "") + '"></td>' +
      '<td class="ep-sub" data-i="' + i + '"></td></tr>';
  }).join("");
  box.innerHTML = '<table class="ep-tab"><thead><tr><th>Task</th><th>Suggested</th><th>Pages</th><th>Minutes</th><th>Counts as</th></tr></thead>' +
    "<tbody>" + rows + '</tbody><tfoot><tr><td colspan="4">Total (limit 30)</td><td class="ep-total" id="ep-total"></td></tr></tfoot></table>';
  function num(v) { v = parseFloat(v); return isFinite(v) && v > 0 ? v : 0; }
  function draw() {
    var tot = 0;
    TASKS.forEach(function (_, i) {
      var r = bud[i] || {}, s = num(r.p) + 2 * num(r.m);
      tot += s;
      box.querySelector('.ep-sub[data-i="' + i + '"]').textContent = s ? s + " pages" : "";
    });
    var el = document.getElementById("ep-total");
    el.textContent = tot + " pages" + (tot > 30 ? ": over the limit by " + (tot - 30) : ", " + (30 - tot) + " left");
    el.classList.toggle("ep-over", tot > 30);
  }
  box.addEventListener("input", function (e) {
    var t = e.target; if (!t.dataset.k) return;
    var i = t.dataset.i; bud[i] = bud[i] || {}; bud[i][t.dataset.k] = t.value;
    K.save("eportfolio-budget", bud); draw();
  });
  draw();
  var ticks = K.load("eportfolio-ticks", {});
  document.querySelectorAll(".ep-list").forEach(function (ul) {
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(ul.children, function (li, n) {
      var id = ul.dataset.ep + n;
      li.innerHTML = '<label><input type="checkbox"' + (ticks[id] ? " checked" : "") + "><span>" + li.innerHTML + "</span></label>";
      li.querySelector("input").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
        ticks[id] = e.target.checked; K.save("eportfolio-ticks", ticks);
      });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
